framework: DIDS-MFL (Disentangled Dynamic Intrusion Detection with Multi-scale Feature Learning)

statistical_disentanglement.description: Non-parametric optimization based on mutual information to separate entangled feature distributions

representational_disentanglement.description: Loss-based regularization to highlight attack-specific features in learned representations
representational_disentanglement.method: Contrastive loss + covariance regularization on latent representations

dynamic_graph_diffusion.description: Graph diffusion on multi-layer dynamic graphs for spatiotemporal aggregation
dynamic_graph_diffusion.method: Temporal GNN with graph attention and edge feature propagation

multi_scale_fusion.description: Multi-scale representation fusion for few-shot attack detection
multi_scale_fusion.method: Bi-similarity metric learning with prototype networks
